errors.evidence: Privacy Protection is shown in red/coral color in the outer ring, not pink. The pinkish/salmon color corresponds to Prioritization or Personalization segments.
Context Retrieving is shown in teal/dark green color, not gray.
Context Tracking is shown in dark navy/slate blue color, not white. White is only the central hole of the donut chart.
Contradiction Resolution is shown in brownish-red/maroon color, not yellow.
Memorization is shown in light cyan/mint green color, not dark blue.
Dynamic Instruction is shown in teal/medium green color, not light blue.
Recursive Reasoning is shown in medium blue color, not red.
The chart is actually a donut/ring chart (with a hollow center), not a standard pie chart. The description fails to note this structural feature.

The chart has an inner ring showing three broader categories (Context Tracking, Contradiction Resolution, Context Retrieving) and an outer ring showing the nine sub-capabilities. This two-ring structure is not described.

Multitasking is shown in dark teal/dark green color. While 'green' is broadly correct, it is shared with other segments. More importantly, Multitasking's value is 160, which is correct, but the color description is imprecise.

errors.text_span: The segments appear ordered visually by decreasing sample values, with "Multitasking" having the highest numerical value and "Recursive Reasoning" the lowest.
errors.evidence: Recursive Reasoning has a value of 110, not the lowest. Multiple categories share the value of 100 (Triggering, Dynamic Environment, Memorization, Dynamic Instruction, Prioritization, Personalization), which are lower than Recursive Reasoning's 110. The segments are not ordered by decreasing sample values.

The description does not mention 'Triggering' (value 100) or 'Prioritization' (value 100) as separate labeled categories, yet all nine categories with their values are labeled externally on the chart.
